title: 「It takes + person ／ time ／ effort + to + verb」
titleZh: 「It takes + person ／ time ／ effort + to + verb」表示所需時間或條件
titleEn: It takes + person / time / effort + to + verb

formula: It takes + time + to + base verb

formulas.formula: It takes + time + to + base verb
It takes + person + time + to + base verb
It takes + effort / patience / courage / practice / skill + to + base verb
How long does / did it take + person + to + base verb?
What does it take to + base verb?

example: It takes time to build trust.

examples.en: It takes time to build trust.
examples.highlight: It takes time to build trust.

examples.highlight: It takes me thirty minutes to get to work.

examples.highlight: It takes courage to admit a mistake.

examples.highlight: How long does it take you to get to school?

meaning.zh: 這個句型說明完成一件事需要多少時間、某人需要多少時間，或需要努力、耐性、勇氣、練習、技巧等條件。

rules.zh: it 是形式主語；真正被談論的事情是後面的 to 不定詞。日常英語通常使用 It takes time to learn a language，而不是把不定詞放在句首。
rules.en: It is a formal subject; the real activity is expressed by the following to-infinitive. Everyday English normally prefers It takes time to learn a language to placing the infinitive first.
examples: It takes time to learn a language.

rules.zh: take 後不只可以放時間，也可以放 effort、patience、courage、practice、skill 或 careful planning 等所需條件。
rules.en: The complement after take is not limited to time. It may name effort, patience, courage, practice, skill, careful planning or another requirement.
examples: It takes careful planning to run a successful event.

rules.zh: 有人物和時間時，人物放在時間之前：It takes + person + time + to + verb。
rules.en: When both a person and a duration are present, put the person before the time: It takes + person + time + to + verb.
examples: It takes Daniel twenty minutes to walk home.
Incorrect: It takes twenty minutes Daniel to walk home.

rules.zh: long 前通常不加 a；可說 It does not take long，或使用完整名詞片語 a long time。
rules.en: Do not normally put a before long. Say It does not take long, or use the complete noun phrase a long time.
examples: It does not take long to finish.
It does not take a long time to finish.

rules.zh: to 後使用動詞原形，例如 to finish、to learn、to prepare 和 to understand。
rules.en: Use the base form after to, such as to finish, to learn, to prepare and to understand.

rules.zh: 不要把所有答案限制在同一位置；本句型可出現在陳述句、問句、否定句、that 子句、how long 間接問句、情態動詞後，或條件及對比句中。
rules.en: Do not restrict the structure to one position. It can appear in statements, questions, negatives, that-clauses, indirect how long questions, after modal verbs, or inside conditional and contrastive sentences.
examples: People sometimes forget that it takes courage to speak honestly.

benefits.zh: 清楚指出完成事情所需的時間、努力、耐性、勇氣、練習或技巧。
benefits.en: It clearly states what an activity requires, including time, effort, patience, courage, practice or skill.

benefits.zh: 用一個直接句型取代較長和重複的說法，使表達更簡潔自然。
benefits.en: It replaces longer, repetitive explanations with a shorter and more direct structure.

benefits.zh: How long does it take ...? 能方便詢問旅程、工作、課程或程序所需時間。
benefits.en: It makes it easy to ask how much time a journey, task, course or procedure requires.

benefits.zh: 除了時間外，亦可表達成功所需的勇氣、自律等較抽象條件，適合作文、演說、建議和反思。
benefits.en: It can express abstract conditions for success, such as courage or discipline, making it useful in essays, speeches, advice and reflection.

benefits.zh: 配合 took、will take、may take 等形式，可以分辨過去實際所需、將來預計所需和可能所需的時間。
benefits.en: It combines easily with different tenses and modal meanings to distinguish past duration, future estimates and possible requirements.

benefits.zh: 可自然放入轉述、報告和較成熟的長句，幫助學生由簡單句發展到完整解釋。
benefits.en: It fits naturally into reported statements and longer explanations, helping learners develop from simple sentences to mature writing and presentations.
